body:
Hello @QuietWind 
I am not able to reproduce the error, can you provide steps to reproduce?

@EugeneHlushko this is not a valid fix. The problem is deeper, but not sure exactly.

@QuietWind Could you create a repro repo?
@sokra this problem is accidental，  I cannot create demo repro.

I got the same error after code refactoring.
Innitlialy I was thinking it was happening only on React components renaming when I had circular-dependency-plugin [https://www.npmjs.com/package/circular-dependency-plugin] switched on.
However it also happened now with plugin switched off on file/module rename.

My version of webpack is 3.10.0.

Hi,

were are seeing those errors quite often since we ran some updates on our stack.
I suspect the fact that we are now using `{ modules: false }` for our `babel-preset-env` config. While we previously was using the default `'commonjs'`.
often the happen this problem！so crazy。。。。

This is happening for me, too. I cannot actively reproduce this but it is constantly happening after a few hot replacements. Restarting webpack always solved it for me. I would like to offer help debugging this but I'm unsure what the next step would be.

This is our current config: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-ce/blob/a28045124f33c67068246df91d9c0ca17c3ad035/config/webpack.config.js

With webpack 3.11.0: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-ce/blob/a28045124f33c67068246df91d9c0ca17c3ad035/yarn.lock#L8778
